name: Succimer

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypersensitivity and dermatologic reactions: Interrupt treatment if rash or mucocutaneous vesicular eruptions occur. ( 5.1 ) Neutropenia: Monitor complete blood counts, interrupt treatment for ANC below 1200/mcL, and monitor for infection. ( 5.2 ) Hepatic Toxicity: Monitor hepatic…

summary: Official warnings note that treatment should be stopped if allergic skin reactions such as rashes or fluid-filled blisters occur [3]. The label also advises watching for infections, tracking complete blood counts to pause treatment if specific infection-fighting white blood cells drop too low, and monitoring liver toxicity [3]. Additionally, a small computer model—not tests done on people—calculated a low liver score of 23 and a low heart score of 2 [M].
